name: Coral Newsprints Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Coral News Prints Ltd engaged in the manufacturing of Newsprints and Absorbent Kraft Papers[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) CNL is in the manufacturing of Newsprints and Absorbent Kraft Papers
b) Newsprint is primarily used for the publication of newspapers, magazines, rough notes, and affordable books.
c) Absorbent Kraft is utilized in the 
manufacturing of laminated mica sheets, 
catering to industrial and commercial 
applications.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
